actions.name: Use
actions.effect: one creature afflicted with Weighted status effect

description.summary: The target for this spell requires the Weighted status effect to be in effect.
description.value: The target for this spell requires the Weighted status effect to be in effect. Once you cast this spell, the Weighted status effect is removed and the creature is pulled into the ground, taking earth damage equal to your caster level (maximum 5) plus your Intelligence modifier per round until freed. While pulled into the ground, the target is considered prone and is unable to move. The target can break free by spending 1 round and making a DC 10 Strength check or a DC 15 Escape Artist check.
